tests.scope: Independent root MSVC /O2 /W4 compile and execution after review fixes; real Windows allocation/unwind APIs on private memory. Generated retail code is never executed.

implementation: Verify the complete five original bodies and generate the previously checked prefix/continuation/unwind image for each.
Allocate one 4 KiB page per image, change the whole allocation to RX, flush its instruction cache and register five RUNTIME_FUNCTION tables before any binding can escape.
Bindings seals the batch before returning typed pointers. Callable storage and OS unwind records then remain until process exit, even after Batch metadata itself is destroyed.
Unpublished cleanup removes each successful registration. If any deletion fails, retain the whole code/table allocation and retry only the unresolved table later.
A failed VirtualFree retains the exact allocation pointer and Error::Free. It cannot report Closed or discard the pointer; the unpublished owner can retry.
All Batch operations require a single serialized installer owner. Entry only exposes a borrowed inspection address; it does not publish callable lifetime.

findingsFixed: Partial RtlAddFunctionTable/RtlDeleteFunctionTable rollback branches lacked execution coverage.
review.conclusion: Final header and full tests reviewed, then production branch and 430-check suite compiled and run independently with zero warnings/failures.
meaningfulCases: OS lookup after cleanup and after Bound metadata lifetime
Full source mismatch and exact typed pointer mapping

limits: No game installation or invocation of generated retail instructions.
Source module and original continuations must remain loaded and intact.
Bound storage deliberately has no teardown. Original-call allocation does not itself establish old-writer drain or Actor lifetime.
